text:
### Authorization (What You Can Access)  
**Role-Based Access Control (RBAC):**
- Customer-facing staff: Limited customer data (own customers)
- Compliance staff: Full data access + audit logging
- Technology staff: System access with audit trail
- Executives: Aggregated reports only
- Developers: Pre-production environments only  
**Segregation of Duties:**
- Account opening != Account approval
- Transaction initiation != Transaction approval
- System administration != Application development
- Audit != Tested system ownership  
**Logging & Monitoring:**
- All access logged (who, what, when, where)
- Audit logs retained 1 year
- Suspicious access patterns flagged
- Periodic access reviews (quarterly)

raw_entities.name: Role-Based Access Control Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing role-based access control and authorization across the bank, defining which staff roles can access specific data and systems. Establishes segregation of duties to prevent conflicts of interest and requires comprehensive audit logging of all access events.
context: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Customer-facing staff: Limited customer data (own customers)
Compliance staff: Full data access + audit logging
Technology staff: System access with audit trail

raw_entities.name: Customer-Facing Staff Data Access Limitation
raw_entities.description: Requires customer-facing staff to access only limited customer data restricted to their own customers, preventing unauthorized access to other customer information.
context: Customer-facing staff: Limited customer data (own customers)

raw_entities.name: Compliance Staff Full Data Access with Audit Logging
raw_entities.description: Grants compliance staff full data access across the bank with mandatory audit logging of all access events for accountability and monitoring purposes.
context: Compliance staff: Full data access + audit logging

raw_entities.name: Technology Staff System Access with Audit Trail
raw_entities.description: Permits technology staff to access systems with all actions recorded in an audit trail for security and accountability purposes.
context: Technology staff: System access with audit trail

raw_entities.name: Executive Access to Aggregated Reports Only
raw_entities.description: Restricts executive access to aggregated reports only, preventing direct access to granular customer or transaction data.

raw_entities.name: Developer Access to Pre-Production Environments Only
raw_entities.description: Limits developer access to pre-production environments only, preventing direct access to production systems and live customer data.

raw_entities.name: Segregation of Account Opening and Approval
raw_entities.description: Prohibits the same individual from both initiating and approving account opening, ensuring independent review and preventing unauthorized account creation.

raw_entities.name: Segregation of Transaction Initiation and Approval
raw_entities.description: Prohibits the same individual from both initiating and approving transactions, ensuring dual control over financial movements.

raw_entities.name: Segregation of System Administration and Application Development
raw_entities.description: Prohibits the same individual from performing both system administration and application development, preventing unauthorized system modifications.

raw_entities.name: Segregation of Audit and Tested System Ownership
raw_entities.description: Prohibits the same individual from conducting audits of systems they own or have tested, ensuring independent audit verification.

raw_entities.name: Comprehensive Access Logging Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates logging of all access events including who accessed what, when, and from where, creating an audit trail for all system and data access.
context: All access logged (who, what, when, where)

raw_entities.name: Audit Log Retention Period
raw_entities.description: Requires retention of audit logs for a minimum of one year to support compliance investigations and historical access reviews.

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Access Pattern Flagging
raw_entities.description: Requires identification and flagging of suspicious access patterns to detect potential unauthorized access attempts or policy violations.

raw_entities.name: Periodic Access Review
raw_entities.description: Mandates quarterly reviews of user access rights to ensure continued appropriateness and identify obsolete or excessive permissions.

raw_entities.name: Access Logging System
raw_entities.description: Technical control that records all access events including user identity, data accessed, timestamp, and location to create a comprehensive audit trail.
context: All access logged (who, what, when, where)

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Access Pattern Detection
raw_entities.description: Monitoring mechanism that identifies and flags unusual access patterns that may indicate unauthorized access attempts or policy violations.

raw_entities.name: Quarterly Access Review Process
raw_entities.description: Periodic control procedure that reviews user access rights on a quarterly basis to ensure continued appropriateness and compliance with segregation of duties.

raw_entities.name: Customer-Facing Staff
raw_entities.description: Staff members with direct customer interaction responsibilities, restricted to accessing limited customer data for their own customers only.
context: Customer-facing staff: Limited customer data (own customers)

raw_entities.name: Compliance Staff
raw_entities.description: Compliance personnel granted full data access across the bank with all access events subject to audit logging for regulatory oversight.
context: Compliance staff: Full data access + audit logging

raw_entities.name: Technology Staff
raw_entities.description: Technical personnel with system access rights, with all actions recorded in an audit trail for security accountability.
context: Technology staff: System access with audit trail

raw_entities.name: Executives
raw_entities.description: Senior management personnel restricted to access of aggregated reports only, preventing direct access to granular data.

raw_entities.name: Developers
raw_entities.description: Software development personnel restricted to pre-production environments only, preventing access to production systems and live data.
